subject: Paper prices from 1 January 2027
body: Thank you for your letter of 2 October about the delivery folders for next year.

From 1 January 2027 our price for the 300 g uncoated folder rises from SEK 14.20 to SEK 15.10 a piece, because the mill has raised its board prices by 6 percent. Orders placed before 15 December are printed at this year's price.
If you would like to fix next year's quantity now, I am glad to send a quotation this week.
